title: betula chinensis var. collina
intro: Betula chinensis var. collina, commonly known as the Chinese birch, is a plant species that belongs to the Betulaceae family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its multiple health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Betula chinensis var. collina include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as betulin, betulonic acid, and flavonoids. These bioactive constituents work synergistically to provide a range of health benefits, making Betula chinensis var. collina a valuable medicinal plant.
